### What M4 asks of the technical side

| Step | Technical |
|---|---|
| [J1](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J1/) An Onesan baby is born in Taifafeki | Document signer certificate (DSC) and its key; HCERT/CWT signing of each DVC. |
| [J2a](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J2a/) A health worker finds the baby — and reads his cards | Read-unverified: the CHW device decodes but does not verify. |
| [J3a](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J3a/) The clinic confirms the cards are genuine | GDHCN trust list (DID documents), cached for offline verification; kid lookup. |
| [J4.0a](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J4.0a/) One phone holds the whole family’s records | Family wallet on one shared phone, one profile and one VHL per member. |
